description: Enclosure and repetition as form: an orderly C# major exposition in a bright room, one fracture that breaks the groove without breaking the grid, a short deep valley with a single pitch standing alone, then five minutes of third-toggle vamp — major and minor undecided on a static C# root — played at volume and ending on the minor side at full volume.
name: monastery

sections.name: Intro
sections.notes: Quietest window (-23.7dB at 0s) but brightest timbre (centroid ~3890Hz). Grid present from 0.98s — the doors are open immediately. Opens G# min, settles C# maj. Light in.

sections.name: Groove A (exposition)
sections.notes: C# major I-IV-V-ii, RMS -13.5 to -12.4dB. The long orderly statement — two minutes of the room being built. Let it ride.

sections.name: Peak A
sections.notes: First loud plateau, RMS -11.4dB mean (180-210s). Full groove at volume, no tricks yet.

sections.name: Fracture
sections.notes: Dropouts at 220-225s and 250s (-18.4dB) with full-level slams between them, then the track's loudest spike (-9.1dB at 265s) right before the valley. Hole -> slam -> hole -> spike. The grid returns every time; the groove is interrupted, not broken.

sections.name: Valley
sections.notes: Deepest sustained dip (-19.8dB at 280s), noisiest moment (ZCR 0.302). Bare G# alone in the chroma at 270s (0.79, everything else <=0.40) — one pitch standing in the empty room. Short: 30 seconds only.

sections.name: Toggle vamp begins
sections.notes: C# minor 300-390s (minor third E mean 0.61, peaking 0.81 at 320s), then the maj/min alternation starts at 420s. RMS ~-14 to -14.9dB plateau. The mode stops deciding — that indecision IS the section.

sections.name: Plateau
sections.notes: RMS -12.3dB at 450-480s, ~-12.5dB through 570s. Toggle continues every 30s. Played at volume, not whispered — the vamp holds its level.

sections.name: Finale
sections.notes: Last dip -17.1dB at 560s as a launchpad, then the climb: -10.7/-10.5dB means, -9.7dB at 615s, peak -1.1dBFS. Darkest timbre by the end (centroid ~2760Hz). Hard stop at full volume, no fade. Last key read C# min — the toggle's last word is minor.

status: analyzed — 8 sections from features + transcript JSONs (dynamics/key/chroma/spectral), 2026-11-06
